timer_semantics: inclusive_ns includes open timers as of the record. Child timers overlap parent timers; never add all phases. final_compact includes final output construction; compact/distribution measure the nested actual compaction/weight processing. group residual includes masking, chooser bookkeeping, setup, teardown and observation overhead.
sampling_policy: tick checks clock every256 calls and emits progress after2 seconds; ticks cover replay boundaries, key candidates, compact clustering, weight sort key extraction and weight accumulation. Each stage logs first64 groups and later powers-of-two begin/end/discard. Requests are only the first accepted lazy request of a run.
group_semantics: group is a per-stage ordinal, not a move identifier. groups_started is cumulative. Phase elapsed and group begin/end records bound observed intervals, not disjoint function costs.
caller_semantics: Only first_lazy_request has caller_file/line/column; others empty/zero. Value and threshold accessors propagate track_caller when enabled; shift identifies Battle::apply check_shift call. No HP read is performed by the observer.
limitations: Diagnostic timing only; not comparable performance.
A long standard-library operation between ticks may exceed the nominal2-second progress interval.
The output session consumes the immediately preceding successful factored enumeration on the same thread; starting another enumeration replaces/clears that diagnostic association.
Counters and timers do not alter battle choices, probability fold order, rollback order or State/Suspension keys.
